additional_info.subject: ID0434995-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / P8 170000861] TPE OOO CRM:00798002275
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
we have checked the logs and charger is having " Preauthorize status Error : Error message : Terminal Candidate List empty "
So, We need to troubleshoot as per following:
This is due to the Bad connection between Processing Unit and Card Reader.
Check, if right ports are used to connect COR A10 to OPM-C60. (As per following)
Check cable connection between Processing Unit and Card Reader.
Re-connect cables and re-start charger.
After Troubleshooting, We need to consider replacing the COR A10.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0434995 ﻿from the
